title: Scale-and-add under polynomial encoding
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $m$ be a vector of length $\ell$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $b$ be an element of $\mathbb{F}_2$. For vectors $u,v$ of length $\ell$, encoding $v+bu$ using the monic polynomial determined by $m$ equals the encoding of $v$ plus $b$ times the encoding of $u$ in the corresponding quotient algebra.
